column3: Upon The Towers at Cupertino City Center Mortgage Loan or the West Memorial Place Mortgage Loan becoming a specially serviced loan under the BANK5 2026-5YR22 PSA, the related Non-Serviced Special Servicer under the BANK5 2026-5YR22 PSA will earn a special servicing fee payable monthly with respect to such Mortgage Loan accruing at a rate equal to the greater of (i) a per annum rate of 0.25% and (ii) the per annum rate that would result in a special servicing fee of $5,000 for the related month until the Special Servicing Loan Event (as defined in the BANK5 2026-5YR22 PSA) no longer exists.
